files.description: The sole EHI export documentation artifact: a 12-page PDF describing talkEHR's b(10) export approach. Contains C-CDA R2.1 field mapping with XPATHs and code systems (pages 6-10), export UI instructions with screenshots (pages 3-5), and descriptions of PDF-format exports for demographics/insurance, advance directives, appointments, provider-to-patient messages, billing data, and documents (page 11). Also briefly mentions FHIR Bulk Data export (page 12). Created 2023-11-14.

HTML source of the registered mandatory disclosures page. Contains ONC certification details, criteria listing, CQMs, and footer link to the b(10) EHI export documentation PDF. The b(10) link appears under 'Legal & Compliance' in the footer.

Screenshot of the page footer showing the '§170.315(b)(10) Electronic Health Information export - Documentation' link under 'Legal & Compliance' section, along with Real World Testing Plan/Result links and other footer navigation.
Focused screenshot of just the b(10) documentation link element in the page footer.
